contributionSummary: Adds optional per-tier badge emoji settings and uses them in the badge rank-up DM and the /merit list badge fields. Staff manual-merit DMs are unchanged.

publicNote.description: Members now see their merit badge as a picture. The congratulations message you get on reaching a new badge shows your badge and the next one, and the Badge Progress section of /merit list shows your current badge, a progress bar to the next badge, and how many merits you still need.
